WPPIL No.30 of 2021
Shri Vipin Sanghi, C.J.
Shri Ramesh Chandra Khulbe, J.
Mr. Vivek Shukla, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, learned B.H. for 
the State-respondent nos.1 to 3 and 6.
Mr. Piyush Garg, learned counsel for 
respondent no.8.
Mr. Nikhil Singhal, learned counsel for 
respondent no.11.
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, learned counsel 
for respondent no.12.
(Impleadment Appln. IA/4/2022)
By this application, the applicants seek 
impleadment as party respondents in the 
writ-petition. Learned counsel states that 
the applicants purchased the property from 
respondent no.12.
In light of the aforesaid, learned 
counsel for the petitioner does not oppose 
the application. The same is allowed. The 
applicants are impleaded as party 
respondents in place of respondent no.12, 
Smt. Meena Raj Bahadur W/o Raj Bahadur 
which is deleted from the array of the 
parties. The applicants are added as 
respondent nos.12/A to 12/D.
Let amended memo of parties be filed 
by the next date. 2
WPPIL No.30 of 2021
It appears that respondent nos.9,10,13 
and 14 have still not been served.
Issue notices to the said respondents 
returnable on or before 31.08.2022.
Notices be served through S.H.O. 
concerned, who shall ensure service of the 
notices on the said respondents.
None appears for respondent nos.4 and 
5 when the matter is taken up.
Respondent nos.4 and 5 have also not 
filed their counter affidavit(s). We direct 
respondent nos.4 and 5 to personally 
remain present in the Court on the next 
date of listing. They shall also file their 
respective counter affidavit(s) in the 
meantime.
Respondent no.4 should explain as to 
why action has not been taken in terms of 
the appellate order dated 01.07.2020 to 
demarcate the areas which are 
compoundable and which are not, and why 
action for demolition has not been taken in 
terms of the non-compoundable area(s) till 
date.
List the matter on 19.09.2022.
(R.C. Khulbe, J.) (Vipin Sanghi, C.J.)
 03.08.2022
SS
